# utem_notification_rule (Resource)

Manages a UTEM notification rule.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "utem_notification_rule" "critical_alerts" {
  name         = "Critical Finding Alerts"
  description  = "Route critical and high findings to Slack"
  is_enabled   = true
  severities   = ["critical", "high"]
  categories   = ["vulnerability", "misconfiguration"]
  channel_type = "slack"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `channel_type` (String) Notification channel type: slack, email, webhook, or discord.
- `name` (String) Rule name.

### Optional

- `categories` (List of String) Categories to match.
- `channel_id` (String) Channel identifier (e.g. Slack channel ID, email address).
- `description` (String) Rule description.
- `is_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule is enabled.
- `severities` (List of String) Severity levels to match (e.g. critical, high).

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Notification rule ID.
